reasoning: Wrote icsdiff.py in one pass from reasoning alone, as instructed; I did NOT run it on any input, so there may be untested bugs. Design: unfold CRLF/LF continuation lines; hand-written content-line parser that respects quoted parameter values; a component stack so VALARM inside VEVENT is skipped and unbalanced BEGIN/END, missing ':' , missing UID, bad DTSTART/DTEND/DURATION, missing VCALENDAR, unreadable/undecodable files all raise ParseError -> exit 2 with message on stderr. Events keyed by (UID, RECURRENCE-ID or None). Times kept as naive wall-clock values exactly as written (DATE -> 'YYYY-MM-DD', DATE-TIME -> 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM', UTC 'Z' printed as-is in UTC, TZID printed as-is); comparison of start/end uses (all_day, wall time, utc flag, tzid) so a TZID-only change still counts as a change (it would print identical wall-clock strings, a known cosmetic limitation). DTEND falls back to DTSTART+DURATION when present; missing values print '(none)'. SUMMARY/LOCATION are RFC 5545-unescaped. CHANGED header uses the OLD event's start/summary, and every section is sorted by start (all-day sorted as 00:00) with summary/UID tie-breaks; only the changed fields are listed in start,end,summary,location order. Exit 0 with no output when nothing differs, exit 1 otherwise. Unfinished/unverified: no test run; duplicate (UID,RECURRENCE-ID) within one file silently keeps the last one; RANGE on RECURRENCE-ID and X- extensions are ignored.
